description: This PHP source file defines a helper function 'oc_generate_vendor' that generates an autoload script by scanning vendor directories and processing composer.json files to register autoloader entries for various autoloading standards such as PSR-4, PSR-0, classmap, and other files.

methods.name: oc_generate_vendor
methods.description: Generates a PHP autoload file by reading composer.json files in vendor directories and registering autoloaders for PSR-4, PSR-0, classmap, and other files based on the contents of composer.json.
